nom: StriVectin Peptide Plump Collagen Cushion Cream

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one who says results were immediately visible, consistently describe the cream as deeply hydrating and plumping without feeling heavy, several specifically recommending it for dry skin.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin in a humid climate found it hydrating and plumping indoors but noticed her face turning oily once outside in the heat; another with oily skin and dry patches around the chin found it kept her moisturized without issue.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin and rosacea reviewers are split: several report no irritation at all, including one whose rosacea didn't flare, while others had reactions ranging from redness and itching to a diagnosed case of contact dermatitis linked to the product's fragrance and plumping agent.
segments.mature: Older reviewers, including ones in their 70s and 80s, report visibly softer, firmer, more youthful-looking skin, with fine lines and creases fading within days to a few weeks of regular use.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report visibly plumper skin and softened fine lines, laugh lines, '11 lines,' or crow's feet within days to a few weeks, including several in their 40s, 70s and 80s; a couple of long-term daily users say they noticed no difference in their lines or plumping at all.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers across skin types consistently describe the cream as deeply hydrating without heaviness or greasiness, often citing visible plumpness and softness after the first few applications.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive skin, report no redness or irritation; two reviewers instead had reactions involving facial redness, one diagnosed as contact dermatitis linked to the fragrance and plumping ingredients, and another whose face turned red enough that she moved to using it on her neck and chest instead.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers highlight the NIA-114 (niacinamide) and peptide complex as barrier-strengthening, reporting firmer, smoother, more hydrated skin with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers say the cream doesn't clog pores or cause breakouts, and one specifically credits it with helping her post-menopausal breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin generally say it doesn't clog pores and can be used without issue, though one notes her face turns oily once she's outdoors in heat and humidity despite it behaving well indoors.

aspects.libelle: Noticeable floral or mint fragrance bothers some
Refillable jar valued for sustainability and savings
Layers well under makeup without pilling
Can pill if applied too heavily

extraits.texte: The day after the first use it made my skin plump and glass skin look. I put it on on again the following night and broke out in wha looked like hives, red, dry and itchy. Went to drs and said i got contact dermatitis. The ingredients have fragrance, limonene, and synthetic dyes. There is also a plumping agent (i bought because i wanted plumping) that can cause chemical burns. I normaly dont use plumping or items with frgrance but i thought to try it out. All around this was my fault because i know better that fragrance, dyes, and certain extracts and oils should absolutely not be applied to the face but there was hope since most have these certain ingredients and most people are fine. But still steer clear for these certain ingredients just to be safe. Fragrance should not be in skincare yet alone the face!
I really liked this product but it makes my neck and chin itch. If you aren't allergic, this is a great product.

I was gifted this in exchange for my honest review. It was rich and hydrating and went on smoothly. It wasn't sticky and it melted into my skin. So I could apply makeyright away. It didn't make my face greasy but it did make my face red. So I will use it on my neck and chest. There is a fragrance to it. Kind of a rose smell. It does disappear after a little while. The packaging is nice. It is in a jar that you scoop out with your fingers. I would recommend it. Just be careful if you have sensitive skin or rosacea.

extraits.titre: Nice cream but I've noticed no difference
extraits.texte: I bought the cream 50% off as a beautysteal. I'm 55 and have been using it twice a day. The cream is lightweight and has been perfect for summer. I would want something heavier for cold, dry Wisconsin winters however. It absorbs quickly, is not greasy, and does not pill. I have very sensitive skin and it's caused no issues. On the other hand, I have noticed no difference or plumping in my skin. I would buy again as a beauty steal but not otherwise.

As I hit 36 earlier this year, I wanted to change up my morning skincare ritual to make sure that I am giving my skincare a little more TLC. I have noticed dullness creeping in and a little lost of plumpness and elasticity. This moisturizer could not have come at a better time. I am someone with oily skin and living in a super humid environment, so gel based moisturizers for my AM routine is a must. However, this moisturizer is a gel - cream one; it straddles between a gel and full cream consistency. I noticed when I have it on indoors or in a cooler environment, it worked perfectly, leaving my skin looking nicely hydrated and plump. But once I set outside into the sun and started running errands, I can see that my face was a little on the oily side. After seven days of use, I did see my skin looking my full and not as dull. You have to make sure that you skin it well cleansed and prep before to get the best results.

The StrVectin Peptide Plump Collagen Cushion Cream has been a great cream to try for my face. It's lightweight and absorbs into the skin quickly. I've noticed a difference in the hydration level of my skin and I love that my skin is visibly less dry after using it (I have really dry skin). I did not notice any redness or irritation after using it. I love that it includes some collagen to help restore my skin. It doesn't have a strong smell, which is also nice. The packaging feels substantial and high quality and the cream comes in its own packaging, allowing for either refills or easier recycling!

Best moisturizer ever - so silky smooth and light. . . moisture of a heavy night cream with the feel of a light day cream. My mature skin face feels soft and supple and has a dreamy hydrated look. This is the best moisturizer I've tried in years. And it has a lovely light smell too - the hubs loves it too!
